plan.title: Social Hobby System (SF / Bay Area)
model: Three slots per week, never more.
Anchor A: tabletop, same day every week. Attend 4 weeks before judging.
Anchor B: movement plus people (dance or bike). Low intensity, leave early if the back complains.
Rotating slot every 2 weeks: try one new group, then promote, keep, or drop it.
rules: Learn 2 names per visit and write them down. Use them next time.
By visit 3, ask one person where else they play.
Join the group's Discord the first night.
Teach-to-play beats open play while you are new.
